{{Top|leg}}
'''Blubberbirds''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] that were commonly used for cooking. They were served in such dishes as the [[Giju slider]] and the [[Interstellar garden salad]] in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
